summary: Frontend-only e2e test of the Package Gifting UI on web (React) and mobile (Expo web preview). Both surfaces render the gift toggle, reveal email + message inputs on toggle, switch the primary CTA label from 'Buy' to 'Gift', and successfully initiate the gift purchase against POST /api/shop/packages/purchase. Web navigated to Stripe Checkout (cs_test_...); mobile called the same backend and stayed on-screen (WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync is a native API — no-op in Expo web preview but no crash). Regression: with the toggle off the CTA reverts to 'Buy' and existing purchases still show 'Redeem one' with counts intact (3/4 left) on both surfaces. Parity is intact between web and mobile.

integration_issues.flow: Gift purchase card checkout on Expo web preview
integration_issues.issue: buy() uses WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync(checkout_url) which is a native-only API — in the Expo web preview it silently no-ops. Not a bug for real device builds, but reviewers testing via web cannot complete Stripe redirect. Consider window.open fallback when Platform.OS === 'web'.

action_items: (Optional/nice-to-have) On mobile buy(), branch on Platform.OS === 'web' to use window.location.href = checkout_url instead of WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync so the Stripe Checkout redirect works when the Expo app is served via web.
(Pre-existing, not this session) React warns about key being spread into JSX in the RadioLife layout NavItem/Item; unrelated to gifting but worth cleaning up.
critical_code_review_comments: ShopPackagesRadioLife.jsx uses window.location.pathname.split('/shop/packages/')[1] to derive the business id; this is fragile if the SPA ever nests a further segment. Consider useParams() from react-router since this route lives inside RadioLifeOverlay.
Mobile buy() logs no confirmation when card-checkout is triggered from web (WebBrowser is native-only). Consider a Platform-aware branch.
